== Original Members of the Reauthorised BPFK (March 2015) ==
On March 16, 2015, [[selpa'i]] was elected by the 2014 LLG Annual Meeting of the membership to chair the [[BPFK Reauthorization|reauthorized BPFK]]. The following members were appointed by LLG on March 22, 2015:

* la .guskant.
